SHORT_DESCRIPTION: PROMOTING VIETNAM LOCAL SUPPLY CHAIN FOR OFFSHORE WIND
PROJECT_TITLE: Promoting Vietnam Local Supply Chain for Offshore Wind
LONG_DESCRIPTION: The ''Promoting Vietnam Local Supply Chain for Offshore Wind'' has been initiated by EREA (Electricity and Renewable Energy Authority) and Innovation Norway. The main purposes of the study are (i) assisting Vietnam companies within oil and gas sector, shipbuilding, shipping, logistic, ports, supportive industries to leverage their existing knowledge, competence and experience to materialize Vietnam offshore wind potential, which is estimated at 475GW, (ii) sparking partnership between Norwegian companies and Vietnamese companies to locally produce material and equipment for offshore wind. The project budget is co-financed by Royal Norwegian Embassy in Hanoi, Innovation Norway and Equinor. The study will be completed within five months, which will start from December 2020 to May 2021. The study shall be based on existing studies of wind energy potential and development scenarios for Vietnam, and use such studies to establish realistic scenarios for the offshore wind industry growth and demands. Existing roadmap studies and expected actions by government to promote the industry shall be used as reference to build such scenarios.'

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: CLIMATE PROTECTION THROUGH SUSTAINABLE BIOENERGY MARKETS IN VIET NAM
PROJECT_TITLE: Climate Protection through Sustainable Bioenergy Markets in Viet Nam
LONG_DESCRIPTION: Vietnam's economy is booming to such an extent that the country's electricity consumption is expected to triple by 2030. The government is consequently expanding the use of biomass waste for electricity and heat generation to achieve the greenhouse gas reduction targets planned in Vietnam's nationally-determined contributions (NDCs). The project supports the development of a sustainable market in this area, advising consultants, project developers and investors on how to draw up feasibility studies, and providing the authorities with an instrument for the approval of biomass energy projects. It teaches staff from financial institutions how to examine and evaluate applications and develops a financing mechanism to favour suitable investments. The project initiates technology partnerships between national and international companies and research and development institutions to develop locally adapted solutions.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: SUPPORT FOR REALIZING LARGE PRIVATE SECTOR WASTE-TO-ENERGY INITIATIVE IN NORTHERN VIETNAM
PROJECT_TITLE: Support for realizing large private sector Waste-to-Energy initiative in Northern Vietnam
LONG_DESCRIPTION: The Project will establish a waste to energy (W2E) plant for provincial scale municipal waste treatment in Phu Lang ward Que Vo district Bac Ninh prov-ince (semi-urban area). The Project site is a 5-hectare plot leased from the government. Civil works started early 2019. The plot is located close to the Câu river and existing landfills. The investment license land-use license and environmental permit have been granted.The Project will receive municipal solid waste delivered by a local municipal waste management company process it into RDF incinerate it to generate electricity to be fed to the grid operated by the state-owned EVN. The design capacity of the plant is 500 tons of municipal solid waste/day for an electricity production of 10MWe. In addition to municipal solid waste the plant will use some industrial waste. The incineration will use a Circulating Fluidized Boiler (CFB) technology from Finland with emission abatement and effluent treat-ment.The Project includes: -Waste to energy (W2E) plant: waste receiving sorting and processing waste incineration turbine and generator-Fresh water supply system for the W2E Plant including water treatment system-Construction of overhead power lines and stations to evacuate the power to the grid (EVN)-Other facilities such as storage bunkers ash handling effluent treatment plant emission abatement systems-Waste supply chain (Provincial waste management body)The beneficiary organisatoin is Thang Long Energy Environment JSC and the EPC contractor is a major local company. International Cleantech Ventures Finland Ltd (ICVF) has prepared a feasibility study for the project in 2017 how-ever the relevance of the feasibility study is limited due to e.g. alteration of the scope and capacity of the plant. This project is aimed at assessing the Environmental Social and Technical impacts and implications of the Plant.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: VIET/RURAL MV POWER NETWORK REHABILITATION IN FOUR PROVINCES
PROJECT_TITLE: VIET/Rural MV Power Network Rehabilitation in four provinces
LONG_DESCRIPTION: The objective is to improve the capacity of electricity supply to meet the increasing load demand in the future reduce power loss ensure quality and reliability of electricity supply and reduce the selling price to households. The project has been on the drawing board for some time. The original total loan amount was estimated to be about EUR 6.0 million (1999). The project was divided into two phases and the first phase (EUR 3.5 million) has supposedly already been implemented. ELTEL applied in January 2004 for a buyer credit guarantee for the remaining amount of EUR 2.5 million but later (2005) the size of the project was raised to about EUR 9.4 million and the concessional credit requirement to about EUR 7.2 million. The present Feasibility Study proposes a concessional credit of about EUR 6.5 million.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: INITIATIVE ON CLOSING THE INVESTMENT GAP IN SUSTAINABLE INFRASTRUCTURE (CIGI)/INITIATIVE POUR RÉDUIRE LE MANQUE DE FINANCEMENT EN INFRASTRUCTURE DURAB
PROJECT_TITLE: Initiative on Closing the Investment Gap in Sustainable Infrastructure (CIGI)/Initiative pour réduire le manque de financement en infrastructure durable (CIGI)
LONG_DESCRIPTION: CIGI is a joint UNDP-University of Maryland initiative, which aims to support funding of sustainable infrastructure initiatives in developing countries and emphasizes hands-on capacity building and match-making with investors.  The UNDP and University of Maryland will use their convening power to organize meetings where participating developing countries will present a portfolio of sustainable infrastructure projects to potential investors. To achieve this, workshops will be held to build the capacity of these countries to elaborate early investment grade portfolios and increase their likelihood to attract investors by creating an enabling business environment.  Canada's funding will be used to expand investor consultations with developing countries that have been part of the initiative up to now (phase 1), to add in-country capacity building for a new round of developing countries (phase 2), to support their participation to a key preparatory meeting in advance of the UN Secretary-General's Climate Action Summit(September 2019), as well as to provide targeted support to Jamaica's Permanent Representative to the UN in the domain of climate finance and carbon pricing to prepare for the Climate Action Summit. / Le CIGI est une initiative conjointe du PNUD et de l'Université du Maryland, qui vise à soutenir le financement d'initiatives d'infrastructure durable dans les pays en développement et met l'accent sur le renforcement pratique des capacités et le jumelage avec les investisseurs.  Le PNUD et l'Université du Maryland utiliseront leur pouvoir de convocation pour organiser des réunions au cours desquelles les pays en développement participants présenteront un portefeuille de projets d'infrastructure durable à des investisseurs potentiels. Pour ce faire, des ateliers seront organisés pour renforcer la capacité de ces pays à élaborer des portefeuilles de qualité d'investissement précoce et à accroître leur probabilité d'attirer des investisseurs en créant un environnement d'affaires favorable.
